notes: refPriceTHB is an approximate Thai street price entered by hand, not a live price. Check before buying. Specs are from the maker page in specSource (checked 2026-11-11); null = not stated there or the page could not be read. maxGPULengthMM / maxCoolerHeightMM = the largest figure the maker prints (often without a front radiator). radiatorSupport: one entry per position; sizesMM = every size the page lists, maxMM = largest (some pages give only a maximum). fanMounts: { position: { fanSizeMM: count } }; "2x 120/140" = two of either size; shroud = on top of the PSU shroud; a missing position has no mount; bracket and accessory mounts are not counted. drivebays: "3.5" = mounts that take a 3.5in drive, "2.5" = every 2.5in mount including combo bays; 0 = the page lists drive mounts and none of that size. dimensionsMM = depth x width x height as printed. psuFormFactors null = the page gives only a PSU length. frontPanel = what the front face is (mesh, glass or solid), used by the 3D viewer; entered from product photos and not re-checked against specSource, null = not sure. boardMount = how the motherboard is mounted when it is not the usual tower layout: "io-down" = board on the side with its rear I/O facing the floor and the graphics card standing upright in its slot (Corsair 2000D AIRFLOW, per its manual and reviews); missing = standard tower layout. frontIO (optional): front-panel USB-C and USB-A port counts; left out where it was not checked.
